title: Fix leader/admin password validation so 'Liderdoprojetox1' grants access

requirements.text: Update the backend admin password verification so that entering the password string "Liderdoprojetox1" is accepted as correct and returns true from verifyAdminPassword.

quotes: A senha ainda está dando incorreta mesmo estando certa, certifiquese que ao inserir a senha Liderdoprojetox1 o app abre para o lider

acceptanceCriteria: Calling backend.verifyAdminPassword("Liderdoprojetox1") as an authenticated user returns true.
The previous incorrect behavior (returning false for "Liderdoprojetox1") no longer occurs.

requirements.text: Fix the backend stored/default admin password value so it matches the expected leader password "Liderdoprojetox1" (remove the trailing semicolon currently present in backend/main.mo).

quotes: ...ao inserir a senha Liderdoprojetox1 o app abre para o lider

acceptanceCriteria: In backend/main.mo, the adminPassword default value is exactly "Liderdoprojetox1" (no trailing punctuation).
A fresh deploy with empty state allows admin/leader access using "Liderdoprojetox1".

requirements.text: Update any backend allowlisting/admin-grant functions that compare password text (e.g., addAllowlistedAdminPrincipal/addAllowlistedAdmin/removeAllowlistedAdminPrincipal/revokeAllowlistedAdmin) so that the leader password "Liderdoprojetox1" successfully allowlists the caller principal when used from the profile setup admin flow.

quotes: ...ao inserir a senha Liderdoprojetox1 o app abre para o lider

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the admin/leader password "Liderdoprojetox1" via the existing profile setup admin flow results in the caller principal being allowlisted and able to save role=#admin without an Unauthorized error.

requirements.text: Add/adjust a conditional canister state migration so that existing deployed state with the old admin password value "Liderdoprojetox1;" is updated to the new expected value "Liderdoprojetox1" without affecting any other persisted state (including allowlisted admin principals).

quotes: ...ao inserir a senha Liderdoprojetox1 o app abre para o lider

acceptanceCriteria: Upgrading a canister whose stored admin password equals "Liderdoprojetox1;" results in the stored admin password becoming exactly "Liderdoprojetox1" after upgrade.
Upgrading a canister whose stored admin password is already "Liderdoprojetox1" leaves it unchanged.
Allowlisted admin principals remain intact across the upgrade.

requirements.text: Update the frontend admin password submission(s) to treat "Liderdoprojetox1" as the correct password and ensure successful verification grants access (i.e., passing the admin gate / opening the leader experience) when the backend confirms the password is valid.

quotes: ...ao inserir a senha Liderdoprojetox1 o app abre para o lider

acceptanceCriteria: In the AdminPasswordGate screen, entering "Liderdoprojetox1" and submitting results in the success state (gate passed) rather than the "incorrect password" error.
In the ProfileSetupDialog admin role flow, entering "Liderdoprojetox1" allows completion of the flow without showing an "incorrect password" error.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not modify any frontend paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Adding new authentication providers or third-party auth (only Internet Identity remains).
Implementing any new admin dashboard features beyond fixing the password validation/access flow.
